help.keyboardShortcutsContent:
Keyboard Shortcuts:

FILE:
Ctrl+N - New Document
Ctrl+O - Open PDF
Ctrl+S - Save
Ctrl+P - Print
Ctrl+W - Close

EDIT:
Ctrl+Z - Undo
Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z - Redo
Delete - Delete selected annotation
Ctrl+Shift+C - Clear page annotations

VIEW:
Ctrl++ - Zoom In
Ctrl+- - Zoom Out
Ctrl+0 - Actual Size
Ctrl+1 - Fit Width
Ctrl+2 - Fit Page
Ctrl+5 - Thin Lines

TOOLS:
V - Select Tool
1 - Highlight
2 - Freehand
3 - Line
4 - Rectangle
5 - Ellipse
T - Text Box
N - Note
